title: Non existant Support and expensive
body: Support never responds to emails and if you subscribe on their website be very very cautious of the charges after the trial ends.
author: Captain Semtex

title: Taken payment
body:
I’ve noticed a payment come out of my account. I never subscribed to ongoing service and do not give permission to take anymore payments.
The app that I did pay a small fee for is basically something I could do on my own. I’ve removed the app from my device and hope that ai don’t see any other billing happen after doing so.
author: Seriously no nicknames

title: More to see
body: I didn’t realize that the online portal/website has tons of helpful info. I thought it was just the wisey apps. So far I have found a few episodes in their courses to be very useful. The apps are too rutementary to be helpful but the website is good. Perhaps advertise the website on the apps when they open? Something short, a few seconds to say “look here for more help with your day” and have a hyper link.
author: Andy22249

title: Wouldn’t stop charging me
body: I unsubscribed after trying this and I am still being charged $85 US and all different cents so that it can keep charging me. When I go check the app to make sure I am unsubscribed it offered me to resubscribe ! No and also that means I’m unsubscribed and you keep trying to take $85 US and did successfully one time. Stop charging me this is ridiculous!!!!!! :(
author: Vic29:)

title: Scam
body: Con artists targeting people with ADHD and stealing your money. I attempted to cancel the free trials online and one subscription cancelled with a click of a button but the e-books subscription would not allow it and forced a contact us option via message box on the website or phone call.. I requested cancellation via message box well in advance of the free trial period. I got billed 45USD on my credit card so I emailed customer support for a re fund and confirm cancellation of future bills. The response was a long winded bunch of garbage refusing to refund my money. DO NOT trust Wisey.
author: Hammattalex

title: Scam - Find Another App!
body: Useless app, could make a better “habit builder” in my notes app. I was billed for “custom plan” AND “e book plan”which I never signed up for so double the cost for nothing. Waste of money and time. AI Bot Rachel was nice though. Haha.
author: KHD-LMNOP

title: Scam
body:
This is awful that you are scamming people you really suffer with ADHD and promising them a customized plan. Money is short. I just wasted my money on your scam app.

Just get a free habit tracker - it’s all they offer.
author: Vixxynkfsebb

title: Scam
body: Absolute scam!!! They make it impossible to cancel the subscription and even after cancelling they continue charging you. Then you have to contact them via email as they give you no option to cancel on their portal. I am now going through a dispute case with my credit card company after receiving multiple charges a month adding up to hundred of dollars.
author: Ri0ga

title: Not good customer support
body: While trying to find an app that would be for me I stumbled on  this one - there is no trial period where you can try the app first then decide if it is what you need . It is not what I’m looking for and I was charged so I emailed them asking if I could get a refund - in the amount of time that is required - right away ! And they instead sent me options to reduce my cost or sign up for something else . And then cancelled my request for a refund ! I just wanted the refund the app is not what I need  so buyer beware !
author: veeetrraa

title: Scam
body:
They promised a customized plan. They will not provide other than access to download apps which don’t do what they say you’re getting.

30-day Money back guarantee is a scam. They say you need to use the non existent plan for a period of time for a refund. Except there is no plan. Total scam.
author: MJEG!

title: Total scam
body: They promised a customized plan to help.  I received no such plan.  The app is so lame, expecting you to setup your own habits.  I could’ve done that myself for free!  The “courses” were not even remotely helpful.  This was a waste of my money and time.
author: happyorganicmama
